name: actor-finance-monitoring-agent
headline: Financial Analyst AI Agent for Stock Insights
short_description: The FinancialAnalystAIAgent offers advanced stock analytics powered by Phidata and Google Gemini 2.0, providing real-time data and interactive visualizations. With a user-friendly Streamlit dashboard, it delivers actionable insights for informed investment decisions.
author: RauhanAhmed

sections.overview:
The FinancialAnalystAIAgent is a comprehensive stock analysis platform that integrates historical market data from Yahoo Finance with AI-driven insights powered by Google Gemini 2.0 Flash. It provides investors and analysts with interactive candlestick visualizations built with Plotly, risk assessments, and actionable investment recommendations through a user-friendly Streamlit dashboard. The system uses Phidata to connect multiple data sources and analytical frameworks, enabling deep financial analysis based on market trends and historical patterns. Users can query the AI agent with custom questions about specific stocks, receive detailed recommendations, and explore data through configurable parameters managed via YAML configuration.
Real-time stock performance tracking
Investment portfolio analysis
Market trend visualization
Predictive analytics for stock prices
sections.usage:
```
Analyze the following stock data for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Provide a detailed analysis including key metrics, trends, and potential risks. Use the latest available data and generate interactive visualizations to support your findings.
```
